title: One copy only
description:
Make a second launch of an app pass its file to the first one and exit.

```
launch 1 "a.txt": first instance, opens a.txt
launch 2 "b.txt": already running -> sent "b.txt" to instance 1, exiting
instance 1 now has: a.txt b.txt
```
hints: `g_mutexes.insert(name).second` is false when it already existed, which is the "already running" case (lesson 6.01).
Real apps send the file with `WM_COPYDATA` to the first instance's window, or through a named pipe.
requirements: A "named mutex" table (a `std::set<std::string>`) stands in for `CreateMutexW` with `ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS`.
The second instance sends its arguments through a message queue to the first.
The name includes the user, so two users can each run one copy.
stretch: Bring the first instance's window to the front (described in a comment: `AllowSetForegroundWindow`).
